_about: Depop US listing-form catalog for the Thrift Agent. Read from the logged-in create page and Depop web APIs on 2026-10-06 (read-only, nothing saved).

form.title: none - Depop has no title field; the first line of the description acts as the title
form.category: Downshift combobox id group-input: pick "Department > Group > Category" (the 3-level path keys of categories below)
form.fees: No selling fees (US); optional Boost costs 12% - never enable
form.shipping: Depop Shipping (USPS) with a package size

style.note: 32 values (Streetwear ... Whimsygoth) - optional; leave empty unless obvious

attribute_values_note: A key ending _1 is a shorter variant list used by some categories (e.g. Kids). Attributes are optional.
product_types_note: "group/product_type=N": N is the US size set id; "-" means no size field.
known_gaps: Kids > Sleepwear > Robes attributes not read (assume none)
The UI size dropdown lags after a category change; use size_sets_US via product_types_by_department, then pick the matching visible option

Kids > Sleepwear > Robes.note: not read by the scan; assumed like the other Kids sleepwear
